facts: The count filters the caller sequence by installed membership and counts occurrences. The loading caller uses catalogue IDs and catalogue length.
The observed parser does not establish recipe-channel membership or completeness. Installation marks a recipe installed after processing supplied maps.
The current generator and reservation source correspond for the inspected recipe families. This does not prove malformed bake admission or runtime outcomes.
The asset server retains failed load state and error. The project request map keeps existing handles, while the retry action creates a client without resetting residency.
Art-demo readiness checks texture readiness before the oak impostor failure and treats an absent residency resource as ready.
Strategic scene retains a required-asset path error and blocks readiness; reset and scene lifecycle remain open.
Oak and City exhibits have explicit recipe sets; other exhibit IDs use an empty set. is_ready treats an empty iterator as ready.
Art-demo same-ID selection returns without re-requesting; prefetch only loads studio exhibits. The typed command interface has no explicit texture-retry action.
The registered viewer host displays unavailable status and sends show or studio-prefetch commands. Its full body contains no explicit texture-reload action.
The shared required-asset filter uses a procedural texture path prefix and two asset suffixes. The native event carries ID, path and error, while observed consumers retain only a path-based message.
